mechanism: Both drugs are substrates of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, with quinidine being a potent inhibitor of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, potentially increasing ivermectin plasma concentrations and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for ivermectin toxicity signs (neurotoxicity, hypotension); consider alternative antiparasitic or spacing doses; baseline and periodic monitoring of quinidine levels advised.
